[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Snake Dance | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=091 }} [[Snake Dance]] refers to a series of winding mountain paths and snowy valleys that threads its way from the [[Northern Shiverpeaks]] to the southern part of the mountain range. This area is the largest [[explorable area]] in the [[Prophecies]] [[campaign]] and is also the longest area in the game. It contains hostile mobs of wildlife native to the Shiverpeaks, including [[Giant]]s, [[Griffon]]s, [[Nightmare]]s, and [[Troll]]s. The [[Stone Summit]] are found towards the south as well. ==Getting there== The easiest way to reach this area is to first get to [[Camp Rankor]] and head out its northwestern exit. Camp Rankor is usually reached only towards the end of the Prophecies campaign. To reach here from the Northern Shiverpeaks, head south out of [[Beacon's Perch]] and through both [[Lornar's Pass]] and [[Dreadnought's Drift]]; the journey is dangerous for a party of 6 out of Beacon's Perch as the areas are filled with high-level foes. This area lets characters reach [[Droknar's Forge]], and there is a [[Guide to the Beacon's Perch to Droknar's Forge run|Beacon's Perch - Droknar's Forge run]] to allow early access to late-game areas and [[prestige armor]]s. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s: *Northwest, at the exit into [[Dreadnought's Drift]]. *Center, northwest from the exit into [[Grenth's Footprint]]. *Southeast, at the exit into [[Camp Rankor]]. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== ====Collectors==== *{{x}} 5 (20) [[Hagnon Warblade]] ([[collector]] for 5 [[Frosted Griffon Wing]]s) *{{x}} 2 (20) [[Hoknil the Lesser]] (collector for 5 [[Azure Remain]]s) *{{x}} 10 (20) [[Merin Trollsbane]] (collector for 5 [[Mountain Troll Tusk]]s) *{{x}} 1 (20) [[Radamon]] (collector for 5 [[Huge Jawbone]]s) *{{x}} 5 (20) [[Yorik Warblade]] (collector for 1 [[Emboldened Carapace Shield]]) ====Other allies==== [[Dwarf|Dwarves]] ([[Deldrimor]]) *{{w}} 10 (20) [[Dwarven Soldier]] *{{r}} 10 (20) [[Dwarven Scout]] *{{mo}} 10 (20) [[Dwarven Mender]] ===Foes=== [[Dwarf|Dwarves]] ([[Stone Summit]]) *{{w}} 24 (26) [[Summit Giant Herder]] *{{mo}} 24 (26) [[Dolyak Master]] *{{me}} 24 (26) [[Stone Summit Heretic]] [[Elemental]]s (Stone Summit) *{{e}} 10 (24) [[Ice Golem]] (with troll boss; doesn't always [[spawn]]) [[Giant]]s *{{w}} 24 (26) [[Tundra Giant]] [[Griffon]]s *{{mo}} 22 (26) [[Blessed Griffon]] [[Nightmare]]s *{{mo}}22 (26) [[Azure Shadow]] [[Tengu]] *{{r}} 24 (26) [[Avicara Fierce]] [[Troll]]s *{{w}} 24 (26) [[Mountain Troll]] ====Bosses==== [[Giant]]s *{{w}} 28 (30) [[Kor Stonewrath]] → [[Earth Shaker]] *{{r}} 28 (30) [[Thul Boulderrain]] → [[Punishing Shot]] [[Griffon]]s *{{mo}} 28 (30) [[Raptorhawk]] → [[Spell Breaker]] *{{me}} 28 (30) [[Featherclaw]] → [[Mantra of Recall]] *{{e}} 28 (30) [[Old Red Claw]] → [[Mind Shock]] [[Human]]s *{{mo}} 28 (30) [[Marnta Doomspeaker]] → [[Peace and Harmony]] [[Nightmare]]s *{{mo}} 28 (30) [[Fawl Driftstalker]] → [[Signet of Judgment]] *{{n}} 28 (30) [[Cry Darkday]] → [[Blood is Power]] *{{n}} 28 (30) [[Sapph Blacktracker]] → [[Spiteful Spirit]] *{{me}} 28 (30) [[Didn Hopestealer]] → [[Illusionary Weaponry]] *{{e}} 28 (30) [[Sala Chillbringer]] → [[Mist Form]] [[Troll]]s *{{w}} 26 (30) [[Smukk Foombool]] → [[Battle Rage]] *{{r}} 26 (30) [[Whuup Buumbuul]] → [[Escape]] [[Wurm]]s *{{n}} 28 (30) [[Maw the Mountain Heart]] → [[Feast of Corruption]] (doesn't always [[spawn]]) ==Notes== *There are many spots with about five or more [[Stone Summit]] [[corpse]]s that do not vanish like regular corpses, exploited or not. The northern ones sometimes have a [[Tundra Giant]] corpse among them or a single hidden [[Nightmare]]. This is perhaps indicative that the Stone Summit are having difficulty gaining a foothold in this hostile area. *There are many hidden Nightmare groups in this area, concentrated mostly around the center and towards the south. *Many of the foes in this area possess skills that cause [[knock down]]. Skills like [[Ward of Stability]] and [["I Am Unstoppable!"]] will be useful. *The [[Tundra Giant|Tundra Giants]] are aggressive to [[Azure Shadow|Azure Shadows]], and will knock them down with [[Giant Stomp]] if they are in the area. *Although this area's two [[Giant]] [[boss]]es share three spawn points, they are not guaranteed to spawn; sometimes neither will spawn, other times only one will spawn. **The northernmost spawn point for them is very close to the portal to [[Dreadnought's Drift]], making it possible to rezone there to try and make a certain boss appear there if trying to Capture either's elite skill. *A few Blessed Griffon groups can sometimes be seen fighting other groups. *Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.8% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 350|low = 300|high = 418}} **The hidden Nightmare groups can be deadly if they are triggered while engaging another large group. Some of the hidden groups are up to 6 strong. **The Tundra Giants are concentrated in the center and the north. With their knock-downs, it can be relatively easy for them to score a kill if unprepared. **Blessed Griffons employ [[Spell Breaker]], which can be annoying to parties that rely heavily on targeted [[spell]]s. **In the north, along the high mountain path, there are several large overlapping patrols of [[Mountain Troll]]s and Tundra Giants. Take care to note their path before engaging. *For the quickest multiple [[profession]] skill capture running, it is best to start from Deldrimor War Camp and head west through Grenth's Footprint. This will bring you directly to the center of Snake Dance within a couple of minutes, thus closer to most of the bosses, which are in the north side of Snake Dance. {{Explorable areas in the Southern Shiverpeaks}} [[de:Schlangentanz]]
